facts.fact: The Haute Cour Constitutionnelle ruled on 10 July 2024 that the African Union Convention on Cybersecurity and Personal Data Protection (Malabo Convention) and law n°2024-004 authorising its ratification, adopted by the Assemblée Nationale on 20 June and the Sénat on 21 June 2024, conform to the Constitution.
facts.system: Convention de l'Union Africaine sur la Cybersécurité et la Protection des Données à Caractère Personnel (Convention de Malabo)

facts.fact: The African Union Commission's status list of 2 February 2026 records Madagascar's ratification of the Malabo Convention on 17 July 2025, with no signature date shown.
facts.system: African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection

facts.fact: The same status list records Madagascar's instrument of ratification deposited on 15 September 2025.
facts.system: African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection

facts.fact: The OIF says the Malagasy government ratified the Malabo Convention in 2024.
Minister Delmotte says Madagascar signed the Malabo Convention in July 2023.
